Agent Name: Planner

Step Number: 3

Reason for Mistake: The Planner made an error in interpreting the information provided by WebSurfer. WebSurfer's search results showed that Thomas George Bowes-Lyon, Lord Glamis (1801–1834), was the son of Thomas Lyon-Bowes, 11th Earl of Strathmore and Kinghorne. The Planner incorrectly concluded that the father (Thomas Lyon-Bowes, 11th Earl of Strathmore and Kinghorne) was Scottish based solely on his title as a Scottish peer, without considering his actual birthplace, which was Durham, England. The Planner should have focused on the birthplace, which indicates the father was British, not Scottish.
